notable_absence.finding: No Capella management-plane role gate on UDF management either, consistent with the rest of this round.

cross_component_finding: This page introduces a THIRD dimension to the credential-type privilege model, beyond credential-type and clause-type (SELECT/RETURNING): function scope (global vs. scoped). Under Advanced credentials, the required privilege differs by whether the UDF is global or scoped (Global Function Manage vs. Query Manage), while Basic credentials use a single Write privilege for both. This confirms the hypothesis that the round-2 access-control model extends to the UDF surface, but the privilege family keeps growing new named members per statement/scope combination (Write, Read, Query Update, Query Insert, Query Read, Query Manage, Global Function Manage, Query Manage Sequences so far this round) rather than staying a fixed pair - reinforcing the upsert.json/update.json finding that reconciliation should treat this as an open, still-growing family rather than the two promoted concepts alone.
